episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When the daughter of a noble family falls from grace, she receives help from a mysterious man.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Wol Ryung must endure 100 days of sacrifice in order to become a human. Gwan Woong refuses to give up the search for Seo Hwa.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Kang Chi's true nature isn't so easily hidden even though he was raised in a normal household. Yeo Wool is forewarned about a fateful meeting.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Trouble begins for Tae So and Kang Chi when Jo Gwan Woong appears at the Hundred Year Inn with ill-intentions and eyes for Chung Jo.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Kang Chi grows nervous as Chung Jo's wedding day approaches. Yeo Wool is drawn closer to Kang Chi the more they argue.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Kang Chi finds himself powerless as history repeats itself and his family is in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Once Kang Chi discovers what he truly is, he struggles to accept it. Chung Jo finds herself in a familiar situation as seen with Seo Hwa 20 years previous.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Kang Chi learns that in order to achieve his goals, he must practice self-discipline and not rely on brute force all the time.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Dam Pyung Joon devises a plan to take back Lord Park's fortune right from under Jo Gwang Woong's nose.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Kang Chi discovers the truth about Yeo Wool. Meanwhile, Chung Jo is forced to spend time with Jo Gwan Woong.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: When Kang Chi discovers Jo Gwan Woong plans to spend the night with Chung Jo, he devises a plan to rescue her. Yeo Wool is conflicted about her feelings for Kang Chi, knowing he loves Chung Jo.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: When Kang Chi's true nature is revealed to Chung Jo, she cannot find it in herself to accept him.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Mysterious murders begin happening near Moo Hyung Do Gwan, and Kang Chi is targeted as the main suspect.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: The widow of a wealthy Japanese merchant stirs up Jo Gwan Woong at the Hundred Year Inn. Wol Ryung has come back to life, in the form of a Thousand Year Evil Spirit.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: As it becomes apparent that Kang Chi and Yeo Wool are developing feelings for each other, Master Dam forces them to separate and prepares Yeo Wool for her engagement with Tae So.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Kang Chi risks getting kicked out of Moo Hyung Do Gwan while undergoing Gon's famous "Bell Test", while simultaneously learning the value of building trust and relationships with people.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: Tae Seo strikes a deal with Head Merchant Ja Hong Myung in order to take back the Hundred Year Inn.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Chung Jo unknowingly reveals the truth about Wol Ryung's death to Kang Chi, which creates a rift between him and Yeo Wool when it tests their trust in one another.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: When the Head Merchant realizes she's taken her own son hostage, she must decide between saving him or blowing the cover she's worked 20 years for.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Master Dam teaches Kang Chi a hard-learned lesson by putting his own life on the line.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.summary: After a family reunion of sorts, Wol Ryung becomes conflicted between his evil nature and the faded memories that hold the key to his true self.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.summary: Yeo Wool decides to spend three last days with Kang Chi before sending him off to find the Gu Family Book, and in those days she grants him three wishes.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.summary: Kang Chi breaks up with Yeo Wool in order to keep her safe, but finds his decision may have had the opposite effect.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.summary: The battle with Jo Gwan Woong finally comes to an end. Kang Chi and Yeo Wool find out whether or not So Jung's prophecy comes true.
